guidelines.small: text-sm font-medium tracking-wide text-[#2C2C2C] opacity-70 uppercase

visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal. Use shadow-sm for active cards, shadow-md for modals. No large or blurry shadows.
visual_enhancers.gradients: None. Strictly flat, solid colors to maintain clinical clarity.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid #E5E7EB on cards. 2px solid for active states.
visual_enhancers.overlays: bg-black/60 with backdrop-blur-md for alerts and modals.

layouts.app_container: h-screen w-full bg-[#F7F7F7] overflow-hidden flex flex-col font-sans
layouts.header: h-16 lg:h-20 bg-[#FFFFFF] border-b border-[#E5E7EB] flex items-center justify-between px-4 sm:px-8 shrink-0 z-10
layouts.grid: flex gap-4 sm:gap-6 h-full min-w-max md:min-w-0 md:grid md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4
layouts.column: flex flex-col bg-[#F7F7F7] h-full w-[320px] md:w-auto
layouts.column_header: flex justify-between items-center pb-3 mb-2 border-b-2 border-[#E5E7EB] sticky top-0 bg-[#F7F7F7] z-10
layouts.card_list: flex-1 overflow-y-auto space-y-4 pb-8 pr-2 scrollbar-thin scrollbar-thumb-gray-300

kot_card.container: bg-[#FFFFFF] rounded-md border border-[#E5E7EB] p-4 sm:p-5 flex flex-col gap-4 relative overflow-hidden
kot_card.timer: text-xl font-mono font-semibold px-3 py-1 rounded bg-slate-100 text-[#2C2C2C]
kot_card.order_type: text-sm font-bold px-3 py-1 rounded-full uppercase bg-gray-100 text-gray-700
kot_card.items_list: space-y-3 border-t border-b border-gray-100 py-4 my-2 flex-1 overflow-y-auto
kot_card.item_line: flex justify-between text-[#2C2C2C] text-base sm:text-lg font-medium
kot_card.item_note: text-sm text-[#FF3131] mt-1 pl-4 bg-red-50/50 p-2 rounded
kot_card.action_button: w-full min-h-[52px] rounded-md font-bold text-lg transition-colors flex items-center justify-center text-white cursor-pointer active:scale-[0.98]

alert_overlay.container: fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-[#FF3131]/95 backdrop-blur-md
alert_overlay.content: text-white text-center space-y-6 p-12 bg-black/20 rounded-2xl animate-pulse

motion.interactions: Hover states on buttons (brightness 90%), active scale-down for touch targets (0.98).
motion.lists: Staggered fade-in for new KOT cards.
motion.alerts: Strong pulse/bounce for 'New Order' visual alert.
motion.reduced_motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for all heavy animations.

accessibility.touch_targets: MINIMUM 44px, preferred 48-52px for all buttons and interactive elements in kitchen environment.
accessibility.contrast: Strict APCA/WCAG AA compliance. Dark text #2C2C2C on #F7F7F7 and #FFFFFF.
accessibility.test_ids: All interactive elements must include data-testid attribute.
accessibility.font_sizing: Scale fonts appropriately for TV displays vs tablets using CSS clamp() or strict breakpoint variants.

instructions_to_main_agent: DO NOT create components that resemble existing KDS solutions. Stick to the defined color palette and typography strictly.
Use Shadcn UI for dialogs, sheets (settings drawer), dropdowns, and switches, but heavily customize borders and radii to match 5-8px rule.
For the main KDS board, write custom flex/grid layouts with raw HTML/Tailwind to ensure absolute control over columns and card stretching.
Ensure the layout never breaks on horizontal scrolling (TV mode). Columns should have a minimum width of ~320px on small screens.
Avoid using Shadcn 'Card' component for KOT cards if it restricts layout flexibility; use custom div structure with Tailwind instead.
Implement a robust 'mock data' generator for V1 to simulate incoming orders, aging timers, and status changes.
Include a 'demo controls' section in Settings to trigger a 'New Order' alert, simulate delay, etc.
Design for high-speed touch input. Buttons MUST be large, clear, and single-action.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Never center align the app container text globally.
DO NOT use transparent backgrounds for dropdowns or modals over content. Always use solid or blurred semi-transparent backgrounds.
general_ui_ux_design_guidelines: Visual Hierarchy: The token number and timer are the most critical pieces of information. Make them massive.
Action Clarity: Only show ONE primary action button per card depending on its status (e.g., START COOKING).
Glanceability: Statuses should be recognizable from 10 feet away. Use distinct colored left-borders or top-borders for priority (Normal/High/Urgent).
Error Prevention: Out-of-stock toggles should have clear confirmation dialogs.
